ranges.label: 1250 kVA

dutyGuide.situation: Powering a site with no mains supply
dutyGuide.advice: Size for the largest single starting load, not the total. A tower crane starting draws several times its running current — a site running a crane plus offices usually lands at 250 kVA even though the running load looks like 120.

dutyGuide.situation: Standby for a building already on mains
dutyGuide.advice: Size for the load you cannot lose: lifts, pumps, fire systems. That is usually a smaller set than contractors expect, so send us the schedule of essential loads rather than the building's total.

dutyGuide.situation: Long duration on a fixed programme
dutyGuide.advice: Running hours drive cost more than the rate does. On anything over three months, ask about the fuel curve at 75 percent load before you pick a size.
